note: Decision-readiness register: the questions that must be answered, and the information we have and lack, before any decision can be reasonably made. 'We have' states what the project currently holds; 'We lack' states the missing information. Each row links the official source used for verification or the methodology reference. Unverified values are blank, not inferred.

questions.question: Do we have verified, timestamped, pre-kickoff market lines and prices?
questions.we_have: None. Third-party market values are withheld as unverified (F-05, F-23); no operator-native quote is held.
questions.we_lack: Operator-native, timestamped lines/prices with as-of history and settlement/void rules.
questions.why_matters: Without a verified price there is no defined betting edge; gate G5 (operator-native line/price/settlement) and G6 cannot pass.
questions.discovery_action: Secure an official/operator data feed or pre-register a paper price source before any edge claim.

questions.question: Are injury and availability inputs complete, current, and sourced?
questions.we_have: A partial Week 9 capture (JAX/BAL, 28 practice rows) dated 2026-11-04; injury types and game statuses left blank even though the official page publishes them (RV-03).
questions.we_lack: Full-slate, current injury reports with injury type and game status for all games (RV-04).
questions.why_matters: The availability gate (G4) depends on current final injuries/rosters; 'No Injuries Reported' is not clearance.
questions.discovery_action: Schedule a weekly automated fetch of nfl.com/injuries for the full slate; populate verified injury type and game status.

questions.question: Do we have chronological, out-of-sample game results to test skill?
questions.we_have: A Week 1-8 official game log (origination) and Week 9 now final on the official schedule.
questions.we_lack: A pre-registered prospective ledger with aligned leg outcomes and a frozen test count.
questions.why_matters: Gates G3 (chronological split) and G6 (out-of-sample calibration) cannot pass without prospective, out-of-sample evidence.
questions.discovery_action: Build a prospective, pre-registered ledger from official scores/schedules and grade it as games complete.

questions.question: Are bet-leg correlations (parlay and player-prop combinations) measurable?
questions.we_have: Three descriptive team-aggregate correlations; four bet-leg correlations are UNVERIFIED with r=null.
questions.we_lack: Timestamp-aligned paired leg outcomes and market thresholds.
questions.why_matters: Parlay and combo pricing require leg dependence; team-aggregate correlation is not a substitute (A03).
questions.discovery_action: Collect timestamp-aligned paired leg outcomes and thresholds; compute correlation with CIs and multiplicity control.

questions.question: Can luck be separated from skill, and by how much?
questions.we_have: Descriptive correlations; no confidence intervals on the aggregates; no variance partition.
questions.we_lack: A variance-partition / intraclass-correlation estimate with bootstrap CIs and permutation tests.
questions.why_matters: Skill designation requires quantifying and bounding the luck share; luck cannot be eliminated (A04).
questions.discovery_action: Implement bootstrap/permutation skill-vs-luck decomposition and report the luck share with a CI.

questions.question: Are there validated roster / starter-backup (string) signals for offense and defense?
questions.we_have: Injury-report rows (practice status, and officially-published injury type/game status per RV-03).
questions.we_lack: A structured starter/2nd/3rd/4th-string depth chart sourced officially.
questions.why_matters: Lineup-deficiency signals (the project goal) require knowing which string is playing at each position.
questions.discovery_action: Capture official team rosters/depth charts and join to injury status; resolve the active string per position.

questions.question: What are the settlement, void, and exposure rules for the competition?
questions.we_lack: Pre-registered settlement/void rules and exposure/drawdown limits.
questions.why_matters: Gates G7 (net EV after costs/pushes) and G8 (immutable ledger, exposure caps) and any reward require these.
questions.discovery_action: Pre-register paper settlement rules and exposure caps before grading.

questions.question: Is the data feed fresh and unattended?
questions.we_have: A dated snapshot validated/rebuilt by daily CI; no live acquisition.
questions.we_lack: An unattended fresh capture pipeline with a currency guarantee.
questions.why_matters: Staleness (RV-01) blocks any 'current' claim and any strategy promotion that depends on current inputs.
questions.discovery_action: Add a scheduled fresh capture with a currency check and a visible freshness indicator (SU-01).
